title: Cockpit 3.0 Video Overlays Update
description: Zones, proximity warnings, shared annotations and Go to Location, directly on the live video in Cockpit 3.0.
problem: Operators had to switch between the live video and the map to see restricted airspace, point things out to the team or send the drone to a place they could see. Each switch cost time during a live operation.
introduction: Cockpit 3.0 adds four capabilities to the live video. Each one is turned on or off in the Video overlays panel at the bottom-right of the video.

capabilities.name: Zone Overlays
capabilities.description: No-Fly Zones (NFZs) appear on the live video as red shaded areas, and the Geofence as a green outline. Operators can show or hide each type of zone.

capabilities.name: Zone Proximity Warnings
capabilities.description: A red glow on the edge of the video and a distance label warn the operator as the drone approaches an NFZ. The matching zone blinks on the map.

capabilities.name: Live Annotation
capabilities.description: Everyone viewing the same drone sees lines, arrows, circles and symbols drawn on the map or the live video. Marks fade on their own.

capabilities.name: Go to Location from Video
capabilities.description: A right-click on the ground in the payload camera feed opens Go to Location with the coordinates filled in. A pin on the video marks the target.

key_benefits.detail: Restricted zones are visible in the picture the operator is already watching.
Operators see an approaching NFZ before the drone reaches it.
Teams point to the same spot instead of describing it over the radio.

intended_users.value: Navigate and act on what they see without leaving the live video.
Coordinate on the same live feed in real time.

summary: Four live video capabilities, managed from one panel.
Zones and warnings appear on the video itself.
Annotations and Go to Location turn what an operator sees into action.
